column1: # The revocation file revoked (the role certificate contract revoke file, bad_file). The form — README.

column4: note
one line per serial; the order — by value
the last line without LF
an empty file — no revocations
leading zeros are not significant
case does not matter
a repeat by value — one serial, not an error
zero — «0»
there is no decimal notation: 123 — the serial 0x123
an empty line and a line with «#» — skipped
«0x» — an invalid line: the file is invalid as a whole
a space — an invalid line
«#» not at the start of a line — an invalid line
separators — an invalid line
CR — a character outside hex: an invalid line
a character outside hex; valid lines beside it do not save it — the former and the partial are not used
a character — an invalid line
neither revoked nor crl.pem — as an invalid file: fails closed (absent)
both files — the union (both)
crl.pem present, no revoked — not an error (absent)
an invalid revoked with a valid crl.pem — fails closed (both)
an invalid crl.pem with a valid revoked — fails closed (both)
